title: BigBlue 28W Foldable Solar Charger for Camping — USB-C & USB-A, IP44
short_description: Foldable 28-watt solar charger by BigBlue with USB-C and USB-A ports, a digital ammeter and IP44 protection — for camping, hiking and outdoors.
long_description: The BigBlue 28W solar charger (model B401D) is a foldable solar panel with two ports, USB-C and USB-A, according to Amazon. It has a digital ammeter and is IP44 water resistant according to Amazon. The housing is made of polyester fabric and the device weighs 671 g. To use it, unfold the panel and connect your device in direct sunlight. According to Amazon the box contains the solar charger, 2 stainless steel hooks, a USB-C to USB-C cable and a user manual. Please check the exact details and scope of delivery on the Amazon product page before buying.
features: Includes 2 stainless steel hooks (according to Amazon)
buying_angle: Handy for campers and hikers who want to charge a smartphone and other USB devices in sunlight without a power outlet.
